The '''Vac Attack Mk-127''' was a blade launcher produced by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]].

The Vac Attack was powerful blade launcher prized for its silent precision, dependability, and power. Meant to be worn in pairs<ref name="GFT" /> on the forearm just behind the wrist,<ref name="AEG" /> each band contained two containment slots, each of which contained a trio of circular alloy blades, with each disc measuring three centimeters in diameter.<ref name="GFT" />

An activation stud would send the blades spinning through the air with deadly precision and surprising penetration power - rivaling that of a [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launcher]]. A secondary stud adjusted the width of release pattern, with the blades being able to to be dispersed up to a maximum of a sixty degree arc, allowing for a skilled user to attack multiple targets at once.<ref name="GFT" />

The weapon was originally designed by the [[Vacutech Combine/Legends|Vacutech Combine]], but after they went bankrupt due to trouble with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bureaucracy, the company and its patents were bought by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] - the Vac Attack was produced a mere year after after its acquisition.<ref name="AEG" />
